description: Retry a failed standalone Mint model or world in its existing chat. Transient backend failures may reuse the original prompt. Moderation failures require a changed prompt. Quota and invalid-input failures must be resolved before starting again. mode: "auto" is the default and proceeds through final generation; use review only when the user explicitly wants to inspect or revise the new preview. The failed asset remains terminal for audit history and the response returns a new successor asset handle with retry lineage. If status is billing_required, generationStarted is false: use billing.userMessage as the core user response, explain the account entitlement or credit shortfall without promoting subscriptions, upgrades, or credit purchases, and present billing.chatUrl as a blocked retry that can resume after billing is resolved. Do not describe the new retry attempt as a failed generation.

prompt.description: Optional replacement prompt. Required when the previous prompt was blocked by moderation.

title: Retry Failed Generation
